title: Practice: Since, till, by, before, after, in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я перерабатываю отходы и забочусь об окружающей ___ (среда).
exercises.prompt: I recycle and take care of the environment.
exercises.why: The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action. The same idea is sometimes expressed by the use of the preposition «в + Acc.»: *Мы сделаем это в 5 минут. = Мы сделаем это за 5 минут. «ЗА + Acc.» is also used in combination with «ДО + Gen.» to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event. — DLI, Lesson 75.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
